work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
label: The eighth day
def: The day after a full week of seven: the day a boy was circumcised, the day after the sabbath when the first sheaf was waved, and the number of souls saved in the ark.
christ: The eighth day is the first day after the sabbath, the day Christ rose, so it stands for the resurrection, the Lord's Day and the new creation. Circumcision on that day points to the true circumcision of the heart through "Him who rose from the dead on the first day after the Sabbath" (Justin, *Dial.* 41), and Barnabas calls it "a beginning of another world" (*Ep.* 15).
where: Justin, *Dial.* 41 — “The command of circumcision, again, bidding [them] always circumcise the children on the eighth day, was a type of the true circumcision”
Justin, *Dial.* 138 — “being eight in number, were a symbol of the eighth day, wherein Christ appeared when He rose from the dead”
Barnabas, *Ep.* 15 — “we keep the eighth day with joyfulness, the day also on which Jesus rose again from the dead.”
Cyprian, *Ep.* 64.4 (ANF 58) — “the eighth day, that is, the first day after the Sabbath, and the Lord's day, went before in the figure”
Augustine, *C. Faust.* 16.29 — “proved the circumcision of the eighth day to be also prophetical of Him.”
Augustine, *C. Faust.* 12.15 — “That Noah, counting his family, was the eighth; because the hope of our resurrection has appeared in Christ”
